purpose: Public FiveM clothing resources with creator links and server setup notes.

items.name: Graffiti Hoodies Pack
items.author: FlaaDev
items.description: Male and female freemode hoodies in hood-up and hood-down versions, each with eight graffiti textures.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Male and female freemode
requirements: Install the flaadev-8graffitih folder and add ensure flaadev-8graffitih to server.cfg.
Check both freemode models in your server’s appearance menu after the resource starts.

items.name: Judge Robe
items.author: jimgordon20
items.credits: jimgordon20 adapted and released the set. Buckeye923 made the original male robe and grzybeek contributed fixes.
items.description: Courtroom robes for male and female freemode characters.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Male and female freemode
requirements: Use the current Judge_Robe_fivem_f_and_m resource folder from the repository. Start it from server.cfg.
Check the add-on entries in your appearance menu on both freemode models. The author documents fixes in the current release.
items.previewCaption: Screenshot from the creator’s Judge Robe release.

items.name: Simple Summer Dress
items.author: Popcorn Roleplay
items.description: An original female freemode dress with moving fabric and multiple textures.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Female freemode · Free Tebex checkout
requirements: Claim the free item through the creator’s store. The creator ties use to the purchaser’s FiveM server license.
Install the supplied resource according to the creator’s instructions and test the dress while walking and sitting.
items.previewCaption: Product image from Popcorn Roleplay’s dress release.

items.name: Felis Missing Clothing Textures
items.author: Felis Development
items.description: Replacement textures for existing male and female clothing and props that show a checkerboard pattern.
requirements: Start fd_missing_textures before the clothing group, as shown in the README. The separate ydd and images folders are optional reference files.
Test the original clothing slots again after starting the resource. This pack replaces textures in those slots.
items.previewCaption: Texture examples from Felis Development’s release.
